Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate ML/infra technical runthrough and calendar

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Key outcome: VelvCorp wants a hands-on 60–90 minute technical runthrough focused on productionizing the transformer stack (latency/cost tradeoffs, KV caching, batching) and an ops handoff for your infra team.
- Goals for the session: validate throughput/latency expectations on your representative workload, confirm rollout strategy (canary/fallback), and align on observability/alerting needs.

To move forward, can you share 2–3 windows next week that work for the ML + infra leads? We usually run these as a 75-minute session (45m demo + 30m Q&A/plan). Suggested blocks: 60–90 minutes between 9am–3pm PT.

I've attached a brief agenda and an initial mutual action plan for your review (mutual_action_plan_velvcorp.xlsx). Proposed attendees from our side are Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer) and Karthik Iyer (ML/infra lead). If there are any other stakeholders you want on the call (security/ops), please add them.

Also flagging a fallback plan: if we hit capacity constraints on the larger model, we can do a side-by-side of a quantized variant with a synthetic demo and then run a short follow-up live test with your data. We can cover that in the agenda.

Options for next steps:
1) Reply with preferred time windows + attendees,
2) If easier, ping me a Calendly link and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Our infra lead, Alex Nguyen, should be on the call for the ops/rollout portion. I’m looping him in here so he can confirm availability. Alex — are either of those windows workable?

- If you can share the runbook link (read-only) ahead of time, our infra team will review and flag any compliance questions.
